cancel_r11_r15.clock_scope: Recorded elapsed and CPU/wall deltas are finite and aggregated; original clock endpoints were not retained and cannot be independently recreated.
cancel_r11_r15.percentile_scope: Pooled measured per-call nearest-rank. Per-arm host_list N=48 makes p99 the maximum; cancel N=384 gives p99 rank381. No population tail stability or statistical significance is claimed.
cancel_r11_r15.scope: Expected wrong-host refusals plus host_list; CPU denominator is mixed RPCs. VmHWM is sampled after measurement, since exec, including warmup; not per-request allocation. VmRSS before/after are point samples, not idle or peak RSS.

cancel_r14_r15.clock_scope: Recorded elapsed and CPU/wall deltas are finite and aggregated; original clock endpoints were not retained and cannot be independently recreated.
cancel_r14_r15.percentile_scope: Pooled measured per-call nearest-rank. Per-arm host_list N=48 makes p99 the maximum; cancel N=384 gives p99 rank381. No population tail stability or statistical significance is claimed.
cancel_r14_r15.scope: Expected wrong-host refusals plus host_list; CPU denominator is mixed RPCs. VmHWM is sampled after measurement, since exec, including warmup; not per-request allocation. VmRSS before/after are point samples, not idle or peak RSS.

comparison_scope.r11_r15: R11 clean-default versus R14+arena1; combined source plus execution-profile result.
comparison_scope.r14_r15: Same qualified executable, clean-default versus arena1; finite controlled configuration comparison.

gate_proof.monitor_scope: 5-second compiler/known competing optimization/archive process snapshots. No full command lines or environment values retained. This cannot prove absence of every short-lived/background activity.
gate_proof.qualification_audit_scope: Uses the frozen configuration-qualification receipt; the separate independent qualification audit owns complete libtest revalidation.

limitations: Two fresh processes per arm/case do not establish statistical significance.
Native observation stores hashes/validated DTO properties without complete transport bodies; no envelope rehash is claimed.
Host-list p99 has only 48 pooled samples per arm/case and is their maximum.
Native p99 has 192 pooled samples per arm/C and is rank191.
Whole-child HWM includes initialization and warmup; sampled native memory spans all C levels and is not per-C allocation.
Native tree RSS/FD sums are nonsimultaneous; sampled tree CPU is partial and is not the performance numerator.
Recorded CPU/wall and latency deltas are checked and aggregated, not reconstructed from absent original clock endpoints.
No absolute optimum or causal lock-level contention claim follows from these finite results.
All negative directional cases and resource metric errors remain in the evidence.

method.cpu_and_rate: Sum measured CPU or call numerators and divide by all measured calls or summed wall durations; no median-rate substitution.
method.memory: Keep both fresh-process values and their arithmetic median; preserve first-controller versus restarted-controller scope.
method.percentiles: Nearest-rank ceil(p*N) on pooled raw measured latencies within one arm/case/tool. Never average per-process percentiles.

native_r11_r15.memory_scope: Main controller across initial checks, all C levels and warmup; sampled kernel VmHWM and sampled VmRSS peaks are not per-C or per-call allocations. FD permission errors remain visible and do not invalidate separately available CPU/RSS.
native_r11_r15.native_response_proof_scope: Rows carry reply/DTO hashes and successful validation flags, not JSON-RPC bodies. This audit validates their format, identity/matrix, complete-output bindings, and recomputes metrics; it does not claim independently recomputed native transport-envelope hashes.
